claims.evidence: Htt3xFlag knock-in mice (paper Mouse Strains); NCBITaxon:10090 verified in OLS.
Cortical tissue (and, for SILAC heavy, whole-brain tissue) lysed for IP.
Mice harvested at 2 and 10 months of age (paper); 'adult' (EFO:0001272) is INFERRED from those ages, not stated as a stage.
Paper: 'male and female mice' were used and paired IPs within a replicate were sex matched, but no per-replicate sex is given.
LFQ: rep folder (rep1/rep2/rep3) in the raw paths stored inside each deposited .msf; SILAC: '1'/'2' suffix in 20220128_2M{20,140}Q{1,2}_IP file names; paper: isotope-labelled IP-MS in duplicate.
Raw headers read 'Q Exactive HF - Orbitrap MS'; PRIDE and paper agree.
'analyzed by data-dependent LC-MS/MS on a Q Exactive HF'.
Paper: 'protease digestion of the samples using trypsin'; .msf Sequest HT Enzyme Name 'Trypsin (Full)'. (reconcile flagged the PRIDE protocol text, which says only 'protease digestion'.)
Q Exactive HF fragments by HCD only; HCD strings present in the .msf spectrum tables. Not stated in Methods (inferred from instrument).
Q Exactive HF MS2 is Orbitrap-only (inferred from instrument).
Sequest HT node Precursor Mass Tolerance '4 ppm' (paper: 4 ppm). The 15 ppm value in the .msf belongs to the Spectrum Files RC recalibration node.
Sequest HT node Fragment Mass Tolerance '0.02 Da'. Paper prose says '20 ppm' (taken as a unit slip for 0.02 Da); the search output wins. 0.1 Da belongs to the RC node.
'reduced and alkylated with ... TCEP and chloroacetamide'.
'chloroacetamide (1.5 ul of 500 mM)'.

This paper: 'StageTip desalting and peptide fractionation (n = 3 fractions) as previously described (PXD025510)'. PXD025510's protocol: 'fractionated over SDB-RPS StageTips'. No PRIDE:0000550 descendant names SDB-RPS (mixed-mode sulfonated reversed phase); mapping to RP or SCX would be a guess, so the reserved word is kept.
_F1/_F2/_F3 in raw names; paper: n = 3 fractions.
One injection per fraction; the '_rerun' files are the only deposited copy of those runs (no original injection deposited).
From PRIDE files/all.

Heavy reference: strain not stated (not available); one vs several animals not stated, so modelled as one heavy source per IP.
Per-replicate sex not reported (male and female, sex-matched): characteristics[sex] = not available.

All SILAC runs are 2-month-old mice (paper; heavy reference collected at 2 months and age-matched); age is constant here, so no factor value[age]. characteristics[age] is not licensed for vertebrates; developmental stage 'adult' is inferred.
Fractionation chemistry only cited to a previous study: comment[fractionation method] = not available.
